feedback.goal: Connect privacy-safe terminal run-mode records to controller estimation without manual fixture rewriting.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Two compatible closed final session records feed one controller estimate directly.
Checkpoints, incomplete sessions, unsupported reasons, non-canonical tools, and context mismatches remain unbatched.
Emitted records validate, persist token counts, reject unsafe metadata, and exclude raw session payloads.
The bridge remains recording-only and performs no model, proposal, application, promotion, or rollback action.
Canonical documentation, capsule digests, evidence-store tracking, typecheck, build, tests, policy, and evaluations agree.

outcome.summary: The run recorder now emits pinned, controller-eligible closed terminal records while failing closed for ineligible or unsafe observations.

what_worked: The existing run-record and controller seams supported a direct integration without changing controller selection semantics.
Focused generated-record tests caught checkpoint duplication, context drift, unsupported terminal reasons, and privacy regressions.
The complete repository gate passed after capsule and evidence synchronization.
what_failed: Early review iterations found disposal, terminal-reason, identifier, privacy, and provenance edge cases; each was corrected before the final gate.

calls.name: vitest
calls.purpose: Verify recorder projection, terminal eligibility, direct controller estimation, and initialization tracking.

calls.name: typescript
calls.purpose: Typecheck the repository and standalone plugin packages.

calls.name: cavecrew-reviewer
calls.purpose: Audit the complete diff for correctness, privacy, provenance, and regression risks.

calls.name: pnpm-check
calls.purpose: Run typecheck, build, all tests, capsule validation, policy evaluation, and benchmark evaluation.

failures_and_inefficiencies.summary: Several fail-closed edge cases required iterative review before the implementation was complete.
failures_and_inefficiencies.suggested_action: Keep the focused generated-record regressions and automated diff review in future recorder changes.

evidence.summary: Focused recorder and initialization suites passed 18 tests.
The complete gate passed with 32 test files, 197 passing tests, 6 opt-in skips, valid capsules, and passing policy and evaluation scorecards.
Final automated diff review reported no findings.
The persisted run contract represents optional aggregate token counters.
The canonical contract defines terminal enrollment and preserves the observation-only authority boundary.
Requirement evidence records the direct bridge, exclusions, privacy behavior, and current repository gate.

uncertainty.statement: Harness, model-patch, and context-policy pins unavailable from session events remain human-configured provenance declarations.
uncertainty.resolution: A future approved runtime integration can bind these values to a signed or immutable DSH generation manifest.

uncertainty.statement: The bridge was exercised through generated Cordis/session events, not an installed DSH profile generation.
uncertainty.resolution: Separately approve an exact plugin mount and run a real lifecycle probe before claiming mounted-runtime proof.

notes: Automated review is recorded as verification, not human approval.
